steps.name: dragResult
steps.script: var g = document.querySelector('#er-diagram-tables > g:nth-child(1)'); var rect = g.getBoundingClientRect(); var startX = rect.left + 10, startY = rect.top + 10; var dx = 180, dy = 140; function fire(type, x, y) { g.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { pointerId: 1, clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true })); } fire('pointerdown', startX, startY); fire('pointermove', startX + dx, startY + dy); fire('pointerup', startX + dx, startY + dy); var conn = document.querySelector('#er-diagram-connectors path'); return { transform: g.getAttribute('transform'), connectorPath: conn ? conn.getAttribute('d') : null };
steps.label: Dispatch real PointerEvents (pointerdown/move/up) simulating a drag of 180,140 and re-read state
